title: Buzznerd Returns for the 3rd Time to Karmak Conference & Expo 2023!
description: Our third consecutive appearance at the renowned Karmak Conference & Expo.

props.text: Events · 1 min read · By Jerry Van Galder
Booth 223 at St. Louis Union Station — AI-powered e-commerce, integrated with Karmak.

It's that time of year again! We're excited to announce our third consecutive attendance at the renowned Karmak Conference & Expo, taking place at the historic St. Louis Union Station from October 3rd–5th, 2023.

items.label: Address: 1820 Market Street, St. Louis, MO 63103

props.text: Buzznerd will be in full force, showcasing our cutting-edge AI-powered e-commerce solutions seamlessly integrated with the Karmak business system. Whether you're familiar with our offerings or new to them, visiting our booth will give you a firsthand look at the future of trucking e-commerce. Let's connect, discuss, and explore how our solutions can propel your business to new heights. St. Louis, here we come!
